## **1. Core Innovation**  
The paper introduces **CODESWIFT**, a novel method designed to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference specifically for code generation tasks. Unlike existing approaches that treat code as generic text, CODESWIFT leverages the unique syntax and semantic structure of code to improve efficiency.

---

- **Parallel Processing**: The approach exploits parallelism in modern hardware architectures to speed up decoding processes.

- **Memory Efficiency**: Optimizes memory usage by leveraging compact representations of code snippets.
